lines.text: Believers are commanded not to be unequally yoked with unbelievers, since light has no fellowship with darkness.
Paul asks what harmony there is between Christ and Satan, and what a believer shares with an unbeliever.
Believers are the temple of the living God, who will dwell with them and walk among them.
The Lord says to come out from among them and be separate, and He will be a King to believers.
Believers are urged to cleanse themselves from everything that defiles body and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.
